name: Customer buys a plant
summary: A customer browses the Fern & Fig plant catalogue, opens a plant they like, adds it to their cart and pays — finishing on an order-confirmation screen. If the plant they want is sold out, they can ask to be notified instead of buying.

steps.label: Browse plants
steps.human: The customer sees the whole plant catalogue as a grid of cards — each shows the plant's name, photo, price and a stock badge.

steps.label: Plant detail
steps.human: The customer opens one plant to see its photo, price and stock, and can add it to the cart.

steps.label: Add to cart
steps.human: The customer adds the plant to their cart and reviews what they're about to buy before paying.

steps.label: Checkout
steps.human: The customer confirms their details and pays; an order is created.

steps.label: Order confirmed
steps.human: The customer sees a confirmation with the order number and what they bought.

branches.label: Notify me
branches.human: Because the plant is sold out, the 'Add to cart' button is replaced with a 'Notify me' button so the customer can be emailed when it is back.

acceptance_scenarios.given: the catalog has in-stock and out-of-stock plants
acceptance_scenarios.then: each plant shows its price and a stock badge (in stock / low / out of stock)

acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer opens its detail page
acceptance_scenarios.then: they can add it to the cart

acceptance_scenarios.given: a plant has been added to the cart
acceptance_scenarios.then: the cart shows the plant, quantity, unit price and a running total before they pay

acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer opens its detail page
acceptance_scenarios.then: the add-to-cart button is replaced by a 'Notify me' action

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cart with at least one item and a known customer
acceptance_scenarios.then: an Order is created with status 'paid' and the confirmation screen is shown
the confirmation screen shows the order number and the paid items
